tool.name: ESMFold API
tool.description: Protein structure prediction via Meta's free API (no GPU needed)

param.name: sequence
param.label: Protein sequence
param.help: Amino acid sequence (max 400 residues). Single chain only.

tool.help:
**ESMFold: Fast Protein Structure Prediction (FREE API)**
Meta's ESMFold predicts protein structure directly from sequence without MSAs. 60x faster than AlphaFold2 while maintaining high accuracy.
**Limitations:** - Maximum 400 residues - Single chain only (no multimers) - No ligands or modifications
**No GPU or API key required!**
For longer sequences or multimers, use Chai-1 or AlphaFold.
**Citation:** Lin et al. (2023). Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model. Science.
